metadata.title: Existence of exhaustions with controlled sign of mean curvature in noncompact manifolds
metadata.abstract: Given a complete and non-compact Riemannian manifold of dimension $3\le n\le 7$, we find conditions for the existence of compact exhaustions $\{U_i\}_{i=1}^\infty$ such that all boundaries $\partial U_i$ have the same sign of mean curvature. In particular, we show that in these dimensions, a manifold with one end satisfying a no tentacle condition always has a weakly mean convex, weakly mean concave, or minimal exhaustion, according to the behaviour of the area profile of separating hypersurfaces. This is a version of a result sketched by Gromov, under a condition which is weaker than his thickness at infinity. In more general situations, we study the existence of exhaustions which are weakly mean concave or weakly mean convex apart from an arbitrarily small $L^1$ error. That is, we find sufficient conditions for the existence of exhaustions $\{U_i\}_{i=1}^\infty$ which satisfy $\int_{\partial U_i}H^+\to0$, $\int_{\partial U_i}H^-\to0$, or $\int_{\partial U_i}|H|\to0$, where $H^-$, $H^+$, and $|H|$ are the negative part, positive part, and the absolute value of the mean curvature respectively. As an application of our methods, we study the existence of almost $c$-convex exhaustions, that is, exhaustions whose boundaries satisfy $\int_{\partial U_i}(H-c)^-\to0$ for some $c>0$.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 非紧流形上的存在定理
analysis.workSummary: 在三至七维完备非紧黎曼流形上，给出边界平均曲率同号的紧耗尽存在条件；一端且无 tentacle 的条件下按分离超曲面面积轮廓得到弱平均凸、弱平均凹或极小耗尽，并推广到平均曲率正负部分 L1 误差趋零的情形。
analysis.breakthrough: 以较弱的无穷远几何条件实现 Gromov 所述耗尽构造，并给出可量化的近似版本。
analysis.limitations: 依据官方标题、摘要及作者评论的摘要级分析，尚未审读数学证明。维数上界及一端、无 tentacle 等假设不可省略；更一般的结论控制积分误差，未必给出逐点同号。 AI 披露以独立全文核查记录为准。
analysis.aiEvidence: AI Statement 明确披露 Claude Opus 5 用于核查证明、检索文献、简化和起草部分论证，以及写作过程中的错误检查。作者同时说明想法和证明属于作者并承担内容责任；不把这些辅助用途扩张成 AI 提出核心想法。
